apparatus.basis: Editor restoration; ⲥⲁⲩϩ ⲁϩⲟⲩⲛ 'gather inward' is the standard Coptic idiom for collective ingathering, fitting the apostle's eschatological gathering of the elect.
Editor restoration of final ⲕ in the emphatic doubled pronoun ⲁⲛⲁⲕ ⲛⲉⲙⲉⲩ ⲁⲛⲁⲕ '(I), I and they, I' setting up the unity-formula in line 12.
Editor restoration of final ⲩ. The 3pl suffix is required by the following ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ 'all of them' at line 13.
Editor restoration of relative ⲉⲧ-ⲥ-ⲉⲓⲣⲉ 'which it (= the Fire, fem.) does'; the relative formula matches the parallel construction in line 21.
Editor restoration of habitual prefix ϣⲁⲥ- 'she habitually...'; the verb ⲥⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ̄ surviving in line 30 confirms the habitual aspect required by the iterative structure of the chapter.
Editor restoration of 3sg.f. suffix referring back to ⲧⲥⲉⲧⲉ 'the Fire' (feminine).

Editor restoration of the standard Kephalaia narrative-frame opener ⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲁⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ ϩⲙⲉⲥⲧ ⲁⲡⲓⲧⲛ 'while the apostle was sitting down,' a stock formula introducing dialogue scenes throughout the corpus (cf. accumulated vocab ⲍⲙⲉⲥⲧ '(was) seated').

notes.decision: Translated 'stand fast' per accumulated glossary entry (ⲧⲏⲕ ⲁⲣⲉⲧ⸗). The perfect ⲉⲧⲁⲓ̈ⲧⲱⲕ ⲁⲣⲉⲧⲧ ⲛ̄ϩⲏⲧⲥ̄ 'in which I have stood fast' describes the apostle's incarnational steadfastness within the icon of the flesh.
Translated 'I have manifested forth.' Standard Coptic ⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ̄ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'reveal/manifest forth.' The line-break splits ⲁⲓ̈ⲟⲩⲱ-(line 1)-ⲛϩ̄ (line 2).

Translated 'to depart for myself to the house.' ⲧⲁϣⲉ here read as conjunctive infinitive of a verb of going (Lyc form on the ⲧⲱⲱϣⲉ/ⲧⲁϣⲟ root, or compressed from ⲧⲁϣⲉⲟⲩⲉⲓ 'go far'); the dative ⲛⲏⲓ̈ + directional ⲁⲡⲏⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲛⲁⲣⲱⲙⲉ 'to the house of my men' confirms a verb of motion-toward-home. The clause expresses the apostle's eschatological return to the heavenly house of his elect.
Translated 'I say it to you.' The ϯ- prefix marks present-I 'I (am) saying'; ⲓ̈ⲙⲁⲥ = ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲥ '(say) it' (3sg.f. obj.); ⲁⲣⲱⲧⲛ̄ = ⲉⲣⲱⲧⲛ̄ 'to you (pl.).'

Translated 'my Wisdom is anointed in them.' ⲧⲁϩⲥ̄ qualitative of ⲧⲱϩⲥ̄ 'anoint, smear, be anointed.' The qualitative naming the indwelling-state of Wisdom in the elect coheres with Manichaean cosmology of light-particles seated within the chosen.
Translated 'shall be joined with them.' ⲧⲱϩ here in conjunctive 'be joined, mingled' (Lyc.) — distinct from ⲧⲱϩⲥ̄ 'anoint' in line 12. With ⲛⲉⲙⲉⲩ 'with them' the unitive sense is required.
Translated 'he said.' Standard Lycopolitan past-speech-introducer (cf. accumulated glossary entry ⲡⲁⲭⲉϩ).

Translated 'it releases' (= dissolves, undoes) per glossary entry ⲃⲱⲗ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'release.' Paired with ⲥⲣⲱⲭϩ̄ 'and burns' in line 22, the doublet 'release-and-burn' is fire's primary destructive operation. Preserves the lexical pair release/raise (ⲃⲱⲗ/ⲧⲟⲩⲱ) of Manichaean soteriology even in this physical-cosmological register.
Translated 'it separates forth.' Habitual ϣⲁ-ⲥ-ⲡⲱⲣⲭ 'she habitually separates' (cf. accumulated ⲡⲁⲣⲭⲟⲩ 'separate them' < ⲡⲱⲣⲭ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ). The 3sg.f. agrees with ⲧⲥⲉⲧⲉ 'the Fire' (fem.).

Translated 'a taste and a savor.' ⲛⲟⲩ†ⲡⲉ = 'a taste' (cf. ⲧϯⲡⲉ 'the taste' in glossary). ⲛⲃⲟ taken as a flavor/savoring-noun parallel to taste; etymology unclear, possibly related to a flavor/relish term. Marked moderate confidence.

Translated 'a salt and a sweetness.' ⲛⲟⲩϩⲓ̈ⲙⲉ tentatively read as 'a salt' (cf. ϩⲙⲟⲩ 'salt' with Lyc. vowel-shift); ⲟⲩⲟⲩⲛⲁϩ tentatively as a flavoring-substance, possibly a sweetness/relish parallel. The pair-structure 'taste/savor (for cooking) + salt/sweetness (for whoever touches it)' fits the gustatory-correspondential register, though both nouns are obscure. Both are flagged as proposed terms.
Translated 'cook' from ⲡⲱⲥⲧ/ⲡⲓⲥⲉ 'cook, boil, ripen.' Cf. accumulated ⲡⲧⲓⲥⲉ 'ripening / cooking.' The future ⲉⲧⲟⲩⲛⲁⲡⲉⲥⲧϩ 'what they shall cook in it' fits the culinary-correspondence register.

Translated 'vessels.' Greek loanword σκεῦος / σκεύη 'vessel, equipment.' Lyc. orthography ⲥⲕⲁⲓⲟⲥ for σκεῦος. Confirmed by collocation with ⲛ̄ⲧⲉⲭⲛⲓⲧⲏⲥ 'artisans' and the verb ⲙⲟⲩⲟⲩⲛⲕ̄ 'mold' — the artisans mold their vessels through fire.

Translated 'the Twelve Zodiac-signs.' ⲙⲛ̄ⲧⲥ = abbreviation/contraction of ⲙⲛⲧⲥⲛⲟⲟⲩⲥ '12'; ⲛϩⲱⲁⲓ = singular of ⲡⲧϩⲱⲁⲓⲟⲛ 'zodiac-sign' (in glossary), here in collective plural construction. The pairing with ⲡ†ⲟⲩ ⲛ̄ⲥⲓⲟⲩ 'the Five Stars (= planets)' confirms the standard Manichaean astronomical pair.
